title: TD2 Comms: Outcasts
summary: A collection of 12 comms from The Division universe, scraped from the Fandom wiki hub page. 12 entries include full audio transcripts; 12 have known map locations.

claims.text: Comm "Cistern": Two Outcasts scouting for communities (Location: Downtown West (1907, 2311))
Comm "Message for Henry": Outcasts deliver a message to Campus leader Henry Hayes (Location: Foggy Bottom (1931, 2427))
Comm "Keeping Survivors": Outcast decide to keep a survivor (Location: Foggy Bottom (1596, 1828))
Comm "Rations": An infected civilian argues with one of Ridgeway's True Sons about the distribution of rations (Location: Foggy Bottom (1772, 1711))
Comm "Plotting": Emeline plots with other people in quarantine to take over the island (Location: Foggy Bottom (1392, 1173))
Comm "True Son Captured": Emeline speaks with a member of the True Sons, her Outcasts have captured (Location: Constitution Hall (1762, 2274))
Comm "Complicit": Outcasts murder civilians for being "complicit" in their suffering (Location: Constitution Hall (1658, 2007))
Comm "Asymptomatic": Emeline provides her doctor with her blood to build a weapon (Location: Constitution Hall (1658, 2007))
Comm "JTF Interrogation": A young JTF soldier is being interrogated and asked why they didn't stop Ridgeway and the others (Location: Downtown West (2006, 1798))
Comm "Condemnation": Emeline explains who she believes is responsible for the Roosevelt Island quarantine (Location: Downtown West (2275, 1972))
Comm "Emeline's End": An Outcast asks Emeline when it will end (Location: West Potomac Park (947, 1525))
Comm "Humanity": Emeline forces one of her Outcasts to confront his wife's killer (Location: West Potomac Park (1190, 1400))
